assets.caption: A life within the stitches.
assets.alt: A partly knitted panel rests on needles beside a ball of yarn, recalling a fictional woman's occupied hours.
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: small closing vignette for a literary cinema book and web article about writer Basanta Kumari Patnaik. Human Natural mode: Poetic Natural. A partly knitted plain pullover panel remains on two ordinary knitting needles, with a small loosely wound yarn ball and a strand joining them. This evokes the woman in In Bondage whose apparently free hours fill with knitting; it is an imagined literary object, not the author's own possessions or hands. No person, table, book, film reel or lettering. Compact shallow horizontal composition, physically plausible yarn loops and needle placement, modest irregular folded fabric, not a decorative display. Fine dark warm-brown ink contours with very selective light hatching, generous true transparent surround. No watercolor background, cast-shadow panel, ornament, signature, watermark, labels or border. At 180 points wide it should read as work paused and time occupied, not a craft tutorial. Full object visible.

assets.caption: A voice finds a listener.
assets.alt: A hand tunes an unbranded radio receiver, suggesting the listener beyond the broadcast.
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. A small literary end vignette for AIR Cuttack, Human Natural Poetic Natural mode. One ordinary adult hand enters from the right and lightly turns the front tuning knob of a small portable radio. An unbranded plain receiver, front speaker grille indicated by only a few ink strokes, no frequency numbers or legible text. This symbolises a voice reaching a listener; not a replica of a 1948 radio, any named person's radio, or an actual broadcast. Thin dark warm-brown ink linework with sparse hatching. Compact horizontal composition with complete radio visible, natural thumb-and-finger grip, other fingers relaxed; simple plausible geometry. No table, desk, book, glowing sound waves, decorative plants, broadcast tower, background, border, watermark or signature. True transparent surrounding space. Read clearly as listening at180pt width, with much less surface detail than a technical engraving.

assets.caption: Words passed between voices.
assets.alt: Two anonymous readers face one another with unlettered script sheets.
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Small closing vignette for playwright Bijay Mishra's profile. Human Natural Poetic Natural. A live reading reduced to its essentials: two anonymous adult readers facing into an open space between them, visible only as partial shoulders, forearms and hands holding separate unlettered script sheets, with just a light suggestion of chin/profile at the upper edges. One reader's sheet higher than the other's. They are reading to one another; no desk, microphone, scenery, theatre costume or stage machinery. Do not depict Bijay Mishra, a named troupe or reconstruct a specific event. Natural grips and sheet weight. Sparse dark warm-brown pen contours, very little hatching, broad true transparent space, shallow horizontal vignette, clear at180pt wide. Do not make a detailed portrait; keep heads mostly outside the suggested scene, use deliberately fading incomplete contours, no abrupt boxed crop, no written dialogue, logos, signature, watermark, decorative aging or border.

assets.caption: Between one position and the next.
assets.alt: Three positions of a paper bird suggest the making of movement between exposures.
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Human Natural Poetic Natural. Small closing line vignette for experimental filmmaker Pramod Pati, about movement created between exposures. Draw a single very simple flat paper bird shape repeated at three successive positions in a shallow left-to-right arc, one position resting, one tilted slightly, one lifting. Thin double edge at a corner suggests cut paper; keep each shape recognisably the same shape. Tiny registration ticks below are enough to suggest successive exposures. A modest conceptual animation study, not a filmstrip or frames from any actual film. Sparse warm dark-brown ink contours, almost no shading, no realistic feathers or origami complexity, no camera or table, no written numbers or text, no arrows, no ornamental border, signature or watermark. True transparent surround and a compact horizontal silhouette. Clear at 180pt wide; uneven gaps evoke experiment rather than a finished corporate diagram.

assets.caption: Listening for what remains.
assets.alt: Plain headphones beside a folded blank sheet suggest listening and a film conceived as a letter.
assets.prompt: Minimal LINE DRAWING with a transparent background: one simple pair of over-ear headphones next to a single folded unlettered sheet of paper. Two-dimensional warm-black pen outlines ONLY. Absolutely no shading, no fill colour, no shadow, no glow, no gradient, no texture, no halo. Like an economical artist's contour sketch with only20 to30 strokes. Headband, two earcups and one short loose cord; natural paper fold. Objects form a small horizontal vignette, generously surrounded by transparency. For Lipika Singh Darai's article about listening and film letters: symbolic, no actual equipment or real letter reproduced. Human Natural Poetic Natural, quiet and modest. No words, branding, border or signature.

assets.caption: The journey before the screening.
assets.alt: An imagined boat carries a closed case, recalling the journeys needed to take films to audiences.
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Human Natural Poetic Natural. A small closing ink vignette for the economics of taking films to audiences, responding to an account of travelling by boat to village screenings. An ordinary modest open wooden boat seen obliquely from above, with a low central bench, a closed plain carrying case on the floor and one oar lying along the gunwale. No people, engine, sail, decorated prow or named landscape. Only a few short lines at the hull suggest water. Boat and case are imagined symbols, not a reconstruction of Lokanath Das's boat, a particular river or a verified projector case. Physically plausible bench/hull/case support. Full hull visible in a low horizontal composition. Sparse dark warm-brown pen contours, very selective light hatching, true transparent surround, no shadows, glow, labels, text, logos, border, signature or watermark. Legible and modest at180pt wide, not a heroic boat scene.
